summary: The proof correctly derives z in A_1 from the accepted slice-convexity fact, applies the planar Grünbaum and Brunn-Minkowski inequalities to obtain the middle-slice bound, and uses an exhaustive comparison of lambda with d to obtain the outer-slice bound. The final depth conclusion follows exactly from the accepted halfspace minimum formula, including both slice-parallel cases. All hypotheses, signs, quantifiers, and boundary cases are handled correctly.
